name: frostsworn-paladin-enter-decline-banish
notes: Frostsworn Paladin (rpOaAjgtue): "On Enter: You may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card and put a buff counter on CARDNAME." Same setup as frostsworn-paladin-enter-banish-floating-draw-buff, but the MZMAYCHOOSE is answered PASS: the graveyard card stays, no card is drawn and no buff counter is placed.

rulesClauses: On Enter: You MAY banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard (optional).
If you don't, no card is drawn and no buff counter is put on Frostsworn Paladin.
